card.name: Decimal point in small dose numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after a leading 0 in dose or coefficient values (0.2, 0.70, 0.24), and sometimes the space before a lab threshold number such as 5.5 mg/dL.

modes.label: Point after zero
modes.description: The period following a leading 0 where a decimal fraction is about to start in a dose or factor.
modes.example: is 0<<.>>2 units per kilogram of body weight

modes.label: Space before lab limit
modes.description: The space just before a serum phosphorus threshold number.

card.writes: It pushes toward the digits of a decimal number and away from the word figure, so the text continues with a number.
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in small dose numbers like 0.2 units/kg, where the next digits are about to appear.
